failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh heartbeat detection and summary output format changed, causing tests expecting 'agent-1', 'Found', and '--force' text to not appear in dry-run output
failures.fix: Update sw-cleanup.sh heartbeat detection section to output 'agent-1' identifier and summary to print 'Found N items' with '--force' hint, or update the test expectations to match current output format

failures.root_cause: sed expression passed without -e flag causes it to be interpreted as a filename; $TEST_TEMP_DIR is unexpanded (literal) making the substitution string an invalid file path
failures.fix: Change `sed 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g'` to `sed -e "s|${TEST_TEMP_DIR}|...|g"` with proper quoting and -e flag in sw-code-review-test.sh

failures.pattern: mktemp: failed to create directory via template ‘/tmp/claude/sw-test-XXXXXX’: No such file or directory
failures.root_cause: mktemp cannot create temp directories under /tmp/claude/ because that parent directory does not exist
failures.fix: Add 'mkdir -p /tmp/claude' before any mktemp calls that use '/tmp/claude/' as the template base, or use the default system tmp dir by omitting the path prefix in the mktemp template
